## Details

<a id="music_song1_voices"></a>
### [`music_song1_voices`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_e8c8.asm#L8) `$E8C8-$E8CF`

*data*

Entry of song 1 in the song table (music_set_voice_pointers reads 8 bytes per song): voice 0, 1, 2 stream pointers and the instrument table pointer. Only voice 0 ($EAB3) points to music; $EB60 and $EC14 point into the sound effect player and its tables. No code selects song 1.
